issue.title: Are Generics not supported?

labels.name: Server
labels.description: This issue applies to the Server side

body:
@phillip-kruger looks like problem is in `SmallRyeGraphQLProcessor.buildExecutionService` replay during STATIC_INIT run. Some NPE is thrown there, but from the zig file it is very hard for me to understand where the problem is. 
But I'm a bit curious why whole `io.smallrye.graphql.schema.model.Schema` generation from java classes is recorded during build, and replayed during the STATIC_INIT then. I'd expect to perform the java instrospection to generate Schema only during the build itself, store it somehow somewhere, and then only use it during STATIC_INIT as is. But I'm a bit new to Quarkus, so I'm not sure if it is possible to do it this way or how to do it. any idea?

Hmm, interesting. NPE was somehow related to `Reference#parametrizedTypeArguments` Map added by me to handle generics. I added cleanup of this map from all References in Schema into `buildExecutionService` step before recording the scheme, and problem is gone. This cleanup should be OK as this info is not necessary at this stage, but I'm going to perform more testing before creating PR
Hi @velias - Great news. Sorry I did not have a change to look at this yet, but seems like you are on it :) Thanks!
